note: SCR-01G (Keen 6): saving a game, from the title as the intro ends (Escape at 33 s: a key that cuts the intro short opens the panel at once in the user's v1.0, the title first in v1.4, J-19). NEW GAME, BEGIN NORMAL GAME (/NOCOPY: v1.0 never asks the creature question (its code is in KEEN6C.EXE but nothing calls it); v1.4, which the port plays, asks at a new game; v1.0 ignores the switch); Escape for the panel in a game: SAVE GAME into the first slot, a name typed (K, E) and Enter, the Saving box; LOAD GAME's card with the saved game; RETURN TO GAME. Menu keys 1.75 s apart, letters 72 tics apart (between two blinks of each cursor). The port's save is kept for scr_end (screen_case.py port ... --keep). Times are seconds after the EGA mode set (KEYFEED.COM types the keys in DOS).
